claims.claim: Ordinary first-party attempts obtain canonical FOUR_SPECIALIZED policy and select the pinned AOA/TCA/MOA/ROA procedures through existing R5 modes, preserving their published pass counts and closure checks.

The caller authenticates canonical Human approval, R5 review/publication lineage, all four profiles and the selected return contract from Git, checks fresh packet identity before admission, and reauthenticates captured bindings at ADMIT and CONTINUE.

First-party negative cases cover missing or conflicting approval, incomplete mappings, unavailable authentication, stale context and forged bindings, asserting rejection before provider invocation without V1/V3 fallback.
Exact-subject Human V1_ONLY substitutes for AOA/TCA; authenticated V1_READ_ONLY preserves normative MOA/ROA without another provider call or verdict.
Historical request constructors and replay lineage remain intact. Continuations retain their captured selection and reject changed canonical sources instead of reselecting a profile.
Direct-final authoring and Runtime/Reviewer/Publisher implementation remain unchanged; regression cases also forbid the new canonical policy supplier on direct-final ingress.

Integration cases invoke the public attempt entrypoint for all four flows and both transports using temporary canonical Git repositories. The commit changes only the eight permitted files and documents approved defaults without roadmap advancement.
